youtube_title: Milk = Gas But Curd Is Fine? Here's Why | Body Fix #15 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #15. Milk = gas and gurgling... but curd is totally fine? How?
B is right. Curd bacteria already ATE most of the milk sugar.
Milk sugar = lactose. Many adults digest less of it: gas, bloat, loose stools.
Fix: Curd or buttermilk instead, small milk with meals, track your triggers.
Red flags: Weight loss, blood in stool, or problems with all food? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NIDDK / NHS - Lactose intolerance
